title: Billing Model Overhaul and Copilot Max Launch
description: GitHub Copilot transitioned from flat-rate request-based billing to usage-based/credit-based billing on June 1, 2026. Introduced Copilot Max as a premium upgrade tier with higher usage limits and increased spending caps. Premium Request Units (PRUs) were replaced with GitHub AI Credits.

community_feedback.quote: Downgrade to Pro and use OpenRouter (same price) for overage. Seems a massive loss for Microsoft.
Angry devs vow to flee GitHub Copilot as metered billing takes hold
End of an Era [June 1, 2026] - GitHub Copilot models and prices
Starting June 1st, GitHub Copilot will move to a usage-based billing model as GitHub Copilot supports more agentic and advanced workflows.
GitHub Copilot Users Get Rude Awakening As AI Pricing Changes - GitHub's internal estimator suggested some users could pay hundreds more under the usage-based model

title: Experimental /security-review Command
description: Added experimental /security-review command to Copilot CLI for AI-driven security reviews that scan local code changes for security vulnerabilities.

title: Gemini CLI Shutdown Announcement
description: Google announced the shutdown of Gemini CLI for free, Pro, and Ultra users on June 18, 2026. Google is transitioning users to the new Antigravity CLI. Both Gemini CLI and Gemini Code Assist IDE extensions will stop serving Google AI requests on June 18, 2026.

community_feedback.quote: It's not an IDE, it's a way to run agents. I expect Gemini CLI getting axed for...
Users reporting performance problems: One user called Gemini CLI 'UNUSABLE' after experiencing 1 minute 4 seconds of processing time
Gemini CLI will stop working from June 18, 2026

title: Windsurf Wave 4 Update
description: Windsurf Wave 4 introduces Previews feature for faster development by selecting elements in preview to send back to editor. New terminal command execution approach using dedicated zsh shell for Cascade agent. Codeium describes this as their 'BIGGEST update yet' with 'game-changing features.'

title: Devin 2.2 Release with Computer Use
description: One of the biggest updates since launch featuring computer use capabilities, self-verify functionality, and auto-fix code features. Updated bundled Devin Local agent to version 2026.5.26 with various bug fixes and performance improvements.

title: Version 0.137.0 Released
description: Fixed configuration writes after plugin installation. Additional performance improvements and bug fixes. Now defaults to GPT-5.5 (released March 5, 2026). The project has seen 553 releases in 10 months with over 9,000+ plugins available.

title: Managed Agents Public Beta
description: Claude Code adds public beta support for Managed Agents that run on schedules (cron-based) and securely use CLI tools and authenticated services. Also includes nested sub-agents for hierarchical workflows and enhanced IDE integrations. Both Codex and Claude Code shipped a /goal command that runs the ralph loop until completion.

community_feedback.quote: Claude Code — best for complex, multi-step tasks where reasoning matters. Terminal-native, no IDE lock-in.
My current daily driver: Claude Code for complex refactors and multi-file changes.
Every Agentic Engineering Hack I Know post received 913K views
With Fable, it's felt like Claude has stepped up from being a coding agent to a thought and design partner in building the product. Fable has judgement, taste...

title: Bugbot Performance Improvements
description: Bugbot is now over 3x faster, 22% cheaper, and finds 10% more bugs. The average review time for Bugbot is now approximately 90 seconds.

title: Organization Management Update
description: The 'Users' tab in org membership page renamed to 'Members' for improved clarity.
